topic: The Waymo effect: how AI is quietly making research less collaborative
headline: AI's Hidden Impact on Research
caption: As a full stack engineer, I see the Waymo effect in action. AI tools are becoming more complex and proprietary, often siloing knowledge instead of fostering open collaboration. This trend worries me because innovation thrives on shared ideas and collective problem-solving. While AI accelerates development, it might also unintentionally hinder the open exchange of research efforts. Staying aware of these shifts is crucial for us as builders to ensure the tech we create benefits everyone, not just a few. Let’s prioritize open collaboration even in AI-driven projects. 🚀 #AI #TechInnovation #OpenResearch
